ability.name: Rocket Ride
ability.note: In its first battle after moving to the field, this Pokémon's Flamethrower becomes Flame Gun (the battle opponent and one Pokémon directly behind it are knocked out). At the start of your turn, instead of an MP move, you may move an adjacent Pokémon to a point 3 steps away from this Pokémon. If you do, this Pokémon moves to the Ultra Space. Your turn ends.
